text.description_html:
RK International CF-983, Modern Cabinet Pull with Ridged Cabinet Cup Pull

The sleek design of the RK International cup pull is made interesting by the ridges at the end, which grant it a contemporary feel. The Ridges at Edge Cup Pull has a 4 inch center to center. It is available in satin nickel, oil rubbed bronze, antique english, and polished nickel finishes. Comes packaged with the installation hardware.

Specifications and Features of the RK International CF-983 4" Ridged Cabinet Cup Pull:

  • Material: Brass
  • Length c.c. (center to center): 4"
  • Length Overall: 4-3/4"
  • Width: 1-3/8"
  • Projection: 1-3/16"
  • Packaged with all necessary installation hardware.

Sold Individually
